newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark will remain within EMU limits through 2005.
newsitem.headline: Denmark will remain within EMU limits through 2005.

text.p: Denmark, which already meets budgetary and employment criteria for economic and monetary union, will continue to do so at least until the year 2005, a new government convergence programme says.
Economy ministry projections published on Monday predict average annual personal consumption growth of 3.1 percent for 1998, revised down from a March estimate of 3.7 percent.
By the year 2005 the rate will be down to 2.3 percent, the report says.
It sees GDP growth at 3.0 percent in 1998, down from its previous forecast of 3.3 percent, while GDP growth in 2005 slows to 2.0 percent.
Inflation is seen as steady, at 2.4 percent in 1998 and 2.3 percent sven years later, with unemployment falling from 7.4 percent in 1998 to 5.0 percent in 2005.

Denmark is bound by a 1993 referendum to remain outside EMU, but intends to abide by the same economic strictures. A new plebiscite, for which the government says it has no immediate plans, would be required to reverse the decision.
